title: RADAR: Real-time Agentic Detection and Reporting
description: Production-shaped fraud detection on AWS. Transactions are scored off a Kinesis stream in 0.4 ms median (717 req/s in the load test) by an XGBoost model that reaches 89.6% recall at a 1% false-positive rate on 606k synthetic transactions; hourly drift monitoring triggers champion/challenger retraining, and a Bedrock tool-use agent investigates every flagged transaction and commits a schema-validated verdict. About 60 AWS resources in Terraform, CI with OIDC deploys, 42 tests.

metric.label: fraud recall at a 1% false-positive rate

title: Customer Churn MLOps
description: Churn prediction that goes beyond risk scoring. An XGBoost model with SMOTE on 7,032 telecom customers (0.82 AUC-ROC) explains each prediction with SHAP, and T-learner uplift modeling separates persuadable customers from sure things, lost causes and sleeping dogs, cutting simulated retention spend by 56%. Served through FastAPI with a Streamlit dashboard; experiments tracked in MLflow.

metric.label: lower simulated retention spend with uplift targeting

title: DeploySmith OS
description: This site. A portfolio that doubles as a multi-agent deployment platform: four LangGraph agents profile a GitHub repo, plan its hosting, build it inside a hardened Docker sandbox and health-check the result, streaming every step to the browser. Deploys are immutable, with build logs and one-click rollback.

title: Proactive Academic Intervention System
description: Flags at-risk students four to six weeks before finals, while there is still time to act. A class-balanced logistic regression (0.887 ROC-AUC, 79.9% recall) blended with rule-based signals scores a 5,000-student cohort into risk bands, and six classical DSA modules, from a max-heap priority queue to sliding-window attendance anomalies, power a Flask dashboard deployed on Render.
